svg.title: Commits per day over 56 days, with merges apart, and under them a grid of the repository's 7 areas showing how many commits touched each one on each day, with the ABI steps and 6 milestones marked.
svg.text: What was worked on, day by day
Every commit to the repository from 28 Aug to 22 Oct 2026, by the day it was written. Above: commits per day, with
the merges that joined parcels to main apart. Below: for each area of the tree, the commits that touched it that day.
commits touching the area that day:
A commit that touches several areas is counted in each, so a column of the grid can add up to more than its bar. The merges join parcels'
branches to main and carry no files of their own, so they are counted apart: 264 of the 1882 commits are merges and 1618 are the work.
Milestones, each the date of the ledger entry that records it:
30 Aug the first card-day images (130 MHz)
2 Sep the sequencer runs on a device
8 Sep first light on the card
6 Oct revision 8's three images on the card
source: docs/figures/history.json (extract; 15f96c8); docs/figures/ledger.json (extract; ledger, first 2,772,018 bytes)
